summary.en: Kogoro received a request from a Ginza barmaid working in Beika to find her missing armadillo. The woman recalled that her pet went missing on their way home around the Birinmon Bridge. She suspected that the armadillo must be in the fish market near the bridge, and worried that he (the armadillo is a male) could have been slaughtered by the fish wholesalers for meat. Location: Birinmon Fish Market Victim: Ginza barmaid's Armadillo Suspects: Birinmon Fish Market's wholesalers A barmaid in Ginza asked Kogoro to investigate a missing armadillo belonging to a her. He went to Birinmon fish market to ask the wholesalers working in Birinmon Fish Market if they saw Armadillo because she was certain that the armadillo went to that market. At the Birinmon Fish Market, Kogoro recalls his conversation with the barmaid to the tuna wholesaler to explain why he was looking for an armadillo in a fish market. The wholesaler holds his big knife and says: So you mean Birinmon Fish Market slaughtered the animal for meat? He warns the detective that they are all honest fish wholesalers before spraying water on Kogoro’s face to chase him off. Kogoro receives the same treatment for three more times with three different tuna wholesalers, for some reason. Kogoro is frustrated with the fact that he gets sprayed with water every time he asks for the armadillo’s whereabouts, so Conan suggests they both go home instead. A taxi also arrives at the location the two are standing, so they decide to have this one take them home. Inside, the driver of the taxi reveals himself to be one of Kogoro’s biggest fans, even going as far as blurting out that he wants to be married to Kogoro Mouri. The detective has no problem with this, and tells the driver to go any route he wants, as long as he drives them home. This reminds the driver about a pair of brothers he picked up yesterday because they did not use the shortest way to travel to their destination, and to thank Kogoro for using his service, he decides to do the same to Kogoro and Conan. Location: Somewhere around a park in Birinmon city (their destination) Suspects: Two singing brothers wearing sunglasses While talking to the extremely talkative taxi driver that is bringing Conan and Kogoro home, he told them about two mysterious brothers not using the fastest route to go somewhere near a park in Birinmon city. The three arrive at a parking lot that is both near a river and a park in Birinmon city. The driver asks Kogoro about the true purpose of the brothers while Kogoro, but he had been sleeping for a while, and he rushes for a toilet instead of answering the question as soon as he wakes up, leaving Conan with the driver. Meanwhile, everyone inside the park in Birinmon City is practicing for the upcoming Ghost Chimney Festival, and the noises of it catch the attention of Conan and the driver, so the two decide to go there. This festival attracts so much public attention that the organizing committee has to use a safe to keep the money made from the festival. During the event, some roads will be restricted to make it easier for that money to be transferred to the bank via their vehicle. Conan, after hearing the details of the festival, understands why the brothers chose to go the long way. He explains it to the driver and Kogoro, who has just returned from the toilet.
